source: NLM RxNorm / DailyMed Consumer Medication Reference

statin_lipid_lowering.hazard_summary: Taking two statin cholesterol medications at the same time increases the risk of severe muscle breakdown (rhabdomyolysis) and liver injury.

oral_anticoagulant.hazard_summary: Concurrent active oral anticoagulants (such as Eliquis/apixaban and Warfarin/Coumadin) carry a life-threatening risk of major gastrointestinal or intracranial bleeding during care transitions.

raas_inhibitor.hazard_summary: Combining two RAAS blockers (ACE inhibitors, ARBs, or Entresto) increases the risk of dangerous drops in blood pressure, high blood potassium (hyperkalemia), and acute kidney injury.

cns_sedative_hypnotic.class_label: CNS Sedative-Hypnotic (Benzodiazepine / Z-Drug — AGS Beers Criteria)
cns_sedative_hypnotic.hazard_summary: Concurrent benzodiazepine and Z-drug sleep/anxiety prescriptions (AGS Beers Criteria) cause additive central nervous system sedation, confusion, orthostatic syncope, and injurious falls.

nsaid_anti_inflammatory.hazard_summary: Concurrent systemic NSAIDs or NSAID use alongside anticoagulants or chronic kidney disease significantly increases gastrointestinal bleeding and acute kidney injury risk.

p2y12_antiplatelet.hazard_summary: Concurrent P2Y12 antiplatelet orders risk accidental double-dosing and major hemorrhage.

sulfonylurea_antidiabetic.hazard_summary: Duplicate or overlapping sulfonylurea prescriptions carry a high risk of severe hypoglycemia (dangerously low blood sugar), especially in older adults or patients with kidney disease.

interaction_hazard_rules.title_template: Concurrent Potassium-Sparing Therapy and Potassium Supplementation ({meds})
interaction_hazard_rules.plain_summary: Your medication list includes both a potassium-retaining water pill ({group_a}) and a potassium supplement ({group_b}). Taking these together—especially with reduced kidney function—can cause dangerously high blood potassium levels (hyperkalemia) that affect heart rhythm.
interaction_hazard_rules.what_to_ask_doctor: My chart shows both {group_a} and {group_b} as active—based on my latest potassium and kidney blood tests, should I stop one or both of these medications?
interaction_hazard_rules.recommendation: Reconcile potassium-sparing diuretic/RAAS therapy against active potassium supplementation and recent serum potassium/eGFR; discontinue potassium supplementation when hyperkalemia (K+ > 5.0 mmol/L) is present.

interaction_hazard_rules.title_template: Concurrent Oral Anticoagulant and Systemic NSAID Therapy ({meds})
interaction_hazard_rules.plain_summary: Your active medication list combines a prescription blood thinner ({group_a}) with an NSAID pain reliever ({group_b}). Taking an NSAID while on a blood thinner greatly increases the risk of stomach ulcers and severe internal bleeding.
interaction_hazard_rules.what_to_ask_doctor: Since I am taking {group_a} as a blood thinner, should I stop taking {group_b} and what safer option can I use for pain?
interaction_hazard_rules.recommendation: Discontinue systemic NSAID therapy in patients receiving oral anticoagulation, particularly after gastrointestinal hemorrhage, and ensure gastroprotection (PPI) if antiplatelet therapy is required.

834061.display: Penicillin V Potassium 250 MG Oral Tablet
834061.plain_purpose: Oral penicillin antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections such as strep throat, dental infections, or sinus infections.

834102.display: Penicillin V Potassium 500 MG Oral Tablet
834102.plain_purpose: Oral penicillin antibiotic used to treat bacterial respiratory, throat, and dental infections.

1535362.plain_purpose: Topical dental fluoride gel applied to strengthen tooth enamel and prevent cavities and gingivitis.

313782.plain_purpose: Non-aspirin pain reliever and fever reducer.

562251.display: Amoxicillin 250 MG / Clavulanate 125 MG Oral Tablet
562251.plain_purpose: Combination penicillin-class antibiotic used to treat bacterial sinusitis, ear infections, and respiratory tract infections.

849574.plain_purpose: Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) used to relieve pain, inflammation, and fever; use with caution in chronic kidney disease.

310965.plain_purpose: Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) for pain and inflammation; use cautiously in patients with reduced kidney function or on antiplatelet therapy.

310798.plain_purpose: Thiazide diuretic ('water pill') prescribed to lower high blood pressure (essential hypertension) and reduce fluid retention.

106892.display: insulin isophane, human 70 UNT/ML / insulin, regular, human 30 UNT/ML Injectable Suspension [Humulin]
106892.plain_purpose: Premixed intermediate- and short-acting human insulin injection used to control blood sugar in diabetes mellitus.

309362.plain_purpose: P2Y12 antiplatelet ('blood thinner') medication that prevents blood clots after coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG), stenting, or in ischemic heart disease.
309362.reconciliation_note: Generic Clopidogrel 75 MG and brand Plavix 75 MG contain the exact same active ingredient; concurrent active prescriptions across clinics risk accidental double-dosing and major bleeding.

213169.plain_purpose: Brand-name clopidogrel antiplatelet ('blood thinner') medication used to prevent blood clots in coronary artery disease and after heart surgery.
213169.reconciliation_note: Brand Plavix 75 MG is identical in active ingredient to generic Clopidogrel 75 MG; verify with prescriber to avoid duplicate antiplatelet therapy.

312961.plain_purpose: HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor (statin) used to lower LDL ('bad') cholesterol and reduce cardiovascular risk in ischemic heart disease.
312961.reconciliation_note: Never take two statins concurrently (e.g., Simvastatin alongside Lipitor/atorvastatin) due to severe risk of muscle breakdown (myopathy/rhabdomyolysis).

617311.plain_purpose: High-intensity HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor (statin) prescribed to lower LDL cholesterol and protect coronary bypass grafts.
617311.reconciliation_note: Therapeutic class duplicate if prescribed alongside another active statin such as Simvastatin; clarify whether Lipitor was intended to replace Simvastatin.

866412.display: 24 HR metoprolol succinate 100 MG Extended Release Oral Tablet
866412.plain_purpose: Extended-release cardioselective beta-blocker used to treat ischemic heart disease, control blood pressure, and reduce heart workload after CABG surgery.

705129.plain_purpose: Fast-acting sublingual vasodilator spray used as needed to relieve or prevent acute chest pain (angina) in ischemic heart disease.

314076.plain_purpose: Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor used to treat high blood pressure, heart failure, and diabetic kidney disease.
314076.reconciliation_note: Generic lisinopril 10 MG and brand Prinivil 10 MG share the same active ingredient; concurrent active orders across clinics risk hypotension, hyperkalemia, and acute kidney injury.

206765.plain_purpose: Brand-name lisinopril ACE inhibitor used to lower blood pressure and protect kidney function.
206765.reconciliation_note: Brand Prinivil 10 MG is identical in active ingredient to generic lisinopril 10 MG; reconcile across clinics to prevent duplicate ACE inhibitor dosing.

1665060.plain_purpose: Intravenous first-generation cephalosporin antibiotic administered before and during major surgery (such as CABG heart surgery) to prevent surgical site infection.

1659263.display: 1 ML heparin sodium, porcine 5000 UNT/ML Injection
1659263.plain_purpose: Intravenous anticoagulant ('blood thinner') used during cardiac surgery, cardiopulmonary bypass, and inpatient hospitalizations to prevent blood clots.

1796676.plain_purpose: Intravenous medication administered at the end of coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) surgery to reverse the anticoagulant effect of heparin.

1740467.plain_purpose: Intravenous anti-nausea medication given during or after surgery to prevent postoperative nausea and vomiting.

311700.plain_purpose: Short-acting intravenous sedative and anti-anxiety medication given before anesthesia or during ICU procedures.

1808217.plain_purpose: Short-acting intravenous anesthetic agent used for induction/maintenance of general anesthesia and ICU mechanical ventilation sedation.

1234995.plain_purpose: Intravenous neuromuscular blocking agent used during general anesthesia to facilitate endotracheal intubation and surgical muscle relaxation.

542347.plain_purpose: Inhaled volatile general anesthetic used to maintain unconsciousness during major surgical procedures such as CABG.

1729584.plain_purpose: Ultra-short-acting intravenous opioid analgesic administered during general anesthesia and cardiac surgery.

1364430.plain_purpose: Direct oral anticoagulant (DOAC 'blood thinner') used to prevent stroke in atrial fibrillation and treat/prevent blood clots.

855332.plain_purpose: Vitamin K antagonist oral anticoagulant ('blood thinner') used for mechanical heart valves, atrial fibrillation, and thromboembolism; requires regular INR blood test monitoring.

313096.plain_purpose: Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist (potassium-sparing diuretic) used in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) and fluid overload; retains potassium in the blood.

628958.display: Potassium Chloride 20 MEQ Extended Release Oral Tablet [Klor-Con]
628958.plain_purpose: Oral potassium electrolyte supplement prescribed to treat or prevent low blood potassium (hypokalemia); must be held if blood potassium becomes high.

310429.plain_purpose: Loop diuretic ('water pill') used to remove excess fluid in heart failure and chronic kidney disease.

1656340.display: sacubitril 49 MG / valsartan 51 MG Oral Tablet [Entresto]
1656340.plain_purpose: Combination heart-failure medication (ARNI) that relaxes blood vessels and improves heart pumping survival in HFrEF.

197901.plain_purpose: Benzodiazepine sedative/anxiolytic medication; listed on the AGS Beers Criteria for older adults due to fall, delirium, and sedation risk.

854873.plain_purpose: Non-benzodiazepine 'Z-drug' sedative-hypnotic sleep medication; high risk of nighttime falls and confusion when combined with benzodiazepines in older adults.

310490.plain_purpose: Sulfonylurea oral diabetes medication that stimulates insulin release to lower blood sugar.

860975.plain_purpose: First-line oral medication for Type 2 Diabetes that improves insulin sensitivity and lowers hepatic glucose production.

197361.plain_purpose: Calcium-channel blocker prescribed to relax blood vessels and lower high blood pressure.

314153.display: Pantoprazole 40 MG Delayed Release Oral Tablet [Protonix]
314153.plain_purpose: Proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that reduces stomach acid to heal peptic ulcers and protect against gastrointestinal bleeding.
